# RevvMotiv - Full Brand & Product Catalog Documentation

> Precision Automotive Aero & Carbon Fiber Styling Components for Drivers Across India.

RevvMotiv is India's premier destination for precision-engineered automotive styling, pre-preg carbon fiber aero components, custom 3D raised tyre lettering, and performance lighting.

---

## 1. Company Overview

- **Brand Name**: RevvMotiv
- **Registered Office & Workshop**: Site-5, Kasna, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306, India
- **Core Specialization**: 1:1 OEM Fitment Aero Splitters, Rear Diffusers, GT Spoilers, 3D Raised Tyre Lettering, Pre-Preg Carbon Styling
- **Customer Support Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 83683 43232 (Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST)
- **Official Email**: support@revvmotiv.com
- **Delivery Coverage**: Pan-India insured express delivery across all PIN codes (5–7 business days)
- **Payment Structure**: 100% Online Payment or 20% Online Advance + 80% Cash on Delivery (COD) via Razorpay
- **Fitment Verification**: Pre-checked by workshop technician before dispatch. Live WhatsApp bumper photo review available.

## 2. Product Catalog Breakdown

### A. Tyre Stickers
1. **Tyre Lettering Kit — White (Set of 8)**: Raised 3D permanent rubber tyre letters in white.
2. **Tyre Lettering Kit — Red (Set of 8)**: Bright red raised rubber tyre letters for track-day contrast.
3. **Raised Rubber Tyre Letters — Universal**: Full alphabet and number set for custom layout.
4. **Permanent Tyre Stickers — Yellow**: High-visibility yellow permanent tyre stickers.
5. **Tyre Sidewall Decal Kit — Silver**: Metallic silver tyre sidewall decal lettering stickers.

### B. Spoilers
1. **GT-Style Rear Wing Spoiler**: Adjustable aluminum uprights with motorsport carbon wing.
2. **Carbon Fiber Trunk Lip Spoiler**: Subtle real carbon fiber weave trunk lip.
3. **Ducktail Spoiler — Universal Fit**: Classic gloss black ducktail trunk spoiler.
4. **Roof Spoiler Extension**: Gloss black hatchback roof edge spoiler extension.
5. **Adjustable Rear Wing with Uprights**: Tall motorsport carbon wing on CNC billet aluminum uprights.

### C. Splitters & Side Skirts
1. **Twill Weave Side Skirt Extensions**: 2x2 twill carbon fiber rocker panel extensions.
2. **ABS Chin Spoiler Splitter**: Lightweight ABS chin spoiler for lower aggressive front stance.
3. **Adjustable Front Splitter Winglets (Pair)**: Carbon fiber adjustable bumper winglets.
4. **Gloss Black Rocker Panel Side Skirts**: Wind-tunnel profiled side skirt extensions in gloss black.
5. **V-Style Carbon Front Lip**: Aggressive V-shape front bumper splitter in twill carbon weave.

### D. Diffusers
1. **Quad-Fin Rear Diffuser**: Four-fin rear diffuser insert.
2. **Carbon Fiber Rear Diffuser**: Real carbon fiber diffuser with deep aero fins.
3. **Gloss Black Bumper Diffuser**: Direct-fit gloss black rear bumper diffuser.
4. **Dual-Exit Diffuser with Fins**: Diffuser designed around dual exhaust tips.
5. **Universal Bolt-On Diffuser Fins (Set of 4)**: Individual bolt-on diffuser fins.

### E. Batman Cover Collection
1. **Bat-Wing Hood Vent Covers (Pair)**: Angular bat-wing bonnet vent covers in gloss black.
2. **Batman-Style Side Mirror Covers**: Angular bat-wing mirror caps.
3. **Bat-Wing Fender Vent Trim (Pair)**: Fender-mounted vent trim in gloss black.
4. **Batman Bonnet Scoop Cover**: Bat-wing outline bonnet scoop cover.
5. **Bat-Style Rear Window Louver Cover**: Rear window louver panel.

### F. Lights & Flashers
1. **OLED Sequential Tails**: Smoked OLED sequential tail light assemblies.
2. **LED DRL Fog Lamp Kit**: Daytime running lights + fog lamp combo kit.
3. **Sequential Turn Signal Mirror Indicators**: Mirror indicators with sequential sweep animation.
4. **Smoked LED Third Brake Light**: Tinted high-brightness LED brake light bar.
5. **LED Headlight Halo Rings (Pair)**: Bright white circular angel-eye halo rings.

### G. Car Audio & Utilities
1. **Component Speaker Upgrade Kit**: 2-way component speaker set with dedicated tweeters & crossovers.
2. **Subwoofer + Amplifier Combo**: Compact active under-seat subwoofer with matched mono amp.
3. **Android Auto / CarPlay Head Unit**: Touchscreen wireless Android Auto & CarPlay double DIN unit.
4. **Dash Cam with Night Vision**: Windshield camera with night vision & hardwire kit.
5. **Wireless Phone Charger Mount**: Vent-mount auto-clamping wireless charger.
